title: Multiscale Reconstruction of Weighted Networks from Coarse-Grained Data
abstract: arXiv:2609.37957v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Network reconstruction from partial information is usually performed at the same resolution level at which constraints are observable. This becomes problematic when only coarse-grained information is available, while the relevant process occurs at a finer scale. Here we employ the multiscale model of weighted networks introduced in a companion paper and turn it into a probabilistic framework for reconstructing weighted networks across arbitrary aggregation levels. The model is built to preserve its functional form under coarse-graining, so that global parameters calibrated on an observable aggregate layer can be transferred to finer layers without refitting. We test the method on two empirical systems with different aggregation mechanisms. translated_title: 从粗粒化数据出发的加权网络多尺度重构
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.37957v1 公告类型： cross 摘要：基于部分信息进行网络重构，通常是在与可观测约束相同的分辨率层级上进行的。当仅有粗粒化信息可用，而所关注的过程发生在更细的尺度上时，这种做法便会产生问题。在此，我们采用了姊妹篇论文中提出的加权网络多尺度模型，并将其转化为一个概率框架，用于在任意聚合层级上重构加权网络。该模型的设计使其在粗粒化过程中保持泛函形式不变，因此在可观测的聚合层上校准的全局参数无需重新拟合即可迁移到更细的层级。我们在两个具有不同聚合机制的实证系统上对该方法进行了测试。在国际贸易网络中，国家被聚合为地理宏区域，观测到的粗粒化层被用来推断潜在的国家层面网络。在荷兰的……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个加权网络多尺度重构的概率框架，利用模型在粗粒化下保持泛函形式不变的特性，将在可观测聚合层上校准的全局参数直接迁移到更细层级，从而仅凭粗粒化数据即可重构细尺度网络。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a probabilistic framework for multiscale reconstruction of weighted networks, exploiting the model's preserved functional form under coarse-graining to transfer globally calibrated parameters from observable aggregate layers to finer scales without refitting, thus enabling fine-scale network reconstruction from coarse-grained data.
